To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) pQCD interactions in the 3+3d parton cascade BAMSP are able to explain the fast equilibration of QCD matter at RHIC, (ii) a subsequent strong buildup and saturation of the elliptic flow v_2 is found in the same model and (iii) a strong jet-quenching is obtained, as measured in the nuclear modification factor for the most central collisions at RHIC.
the RHIC data are explained by a strongly interacting, almost perfect fluid with a very small shear viscosity to entropy density ratio, which arises from a very short thermalization time of 1 fm/c.
the RHIC data on elliptic flow, nuclear modification factor RAA and jet-quenchings are understood as a consequence of pQCD interactions within the 1+1d and 3+1d parton cascade BAMPs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the initial state of the QCD medium created in heavy-ion collisions at RHIC and LHC.

the understanding of the initial stages of the quark gluon plasma created at RHIC, which is of utmost importance for the interpretation of the data and the extrapolation to future experiments at the LHC.
the understanding of the space-time evolution of the quark-gluon plasma (QGP), the strongly interacting quark-gluonic matter, which was created at RHIC.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the pQCD bremsstrahlungs processes in the 3+3 dimensional parton cascade can account for all the phenomena of fast thermalization, strong elliptic flow and the jet-quenching phenomena at RHIC.
the RHIC fireball is a strongly coupled QGP.

the pQCD interactions in the 3+ 1 dimensional parton cascades BAMPS are able to reproduce a wide range of data from RHIC, including the strong buildup of elliptical flow, jet-quenching, and the shear viscosity to the entropy ratio.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the observed phenomena at RHIC are a consequence of the same underlying physics, which is pQCD.
pQCD is the correct theory of the quark gluon plasma.
the RHIC data are consistent with a strongly coupled plasma of partons, which is not too far from the quasiparticle picture.
The main takeaway from our work is that
all of these phenomena are of common origin.
all these observables are intimately connected and can be explained by a single pQCD mechanism, namely bremsstrahlungs processes.

the observed phenomena of fast thermalization, jet-quenching and strong buildup of elliptical flow are of common origin and that the parton cascade BAMBS is a suitable tool to investigate the early stages of the QGP.
